days.storyBeat: The ferry arrives. Everyone is scrambling to set up their favorite spots.

morning.title: Day 1 — Morning Arrival
morning.openingDialogue: Welcome to Hololive Island! The sun is bright, the sand is hot, and three groups are currently fighting for the Manager's attention.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help Sora and Suisei open the mall. Miko found the snacks.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: You enter the mall. Suisei is checking the edge of a display axe. 'It’s too dull, Manager. How can we sell this?'

steps.prompt: The luxury floor needs a lead. Who do you assign?

options.resultDialogue: Suisei turns on her 'Stellar' intensity. The customers are too intimidated to say no to her recommendations.
Sora’s pure idol energy makes the store look like a holy landmark. Fans are lining up just to see her.
She automates the boutiques. High-spec efficiency, though she keeps trying to charge for 'battery cooling.'

steps.prompt: Miko has gotten her head stuck in a snack machine. She claims it 'grabbed' her.

options.resultDialogue: You pull. *POP!* Miko is free, clutching three bags of Elite Taiyaki. She insists she was just 'scouting' the inventory.
Roboco opens the machine remotely. Miko falls out, buried in snacks. 'I'm okay-nye! This was all planned!'
Sora gently talks to Miko, calming her until she can wiggle out. 'Don't do that again, Miko-chan!'

steps.prompt: The first hour is done. Success?

options.resultDialogue: Suisei is already counting the shells. 'Decent start, Manager.'
Sora bows to the guests. The mall feels warm and professional.
Miko shares her taiyaki. It’s warm, delicious, and suspiciously smells like incense.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Mall is open. You found a cold silver medal in the register tray. It looks like an old mirror piece.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help AREA 15 set up the pier market.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Risu is currently trying to hide a crate of expensive almonds. 'Squirrel instincts, Manager!'

steps.prompt: The mangoes are rolling down the pier. Help?

options.resultDialogue: She uses gravity to stop the fruit. It's efficient, but now the mangoes are floating 5 feet up. Reach for them!
She offers to help... if you sign a contract giving her 10% of your nuts. You negotiate her down to a headpat.
She is painting the stand. It looks incredibly vibrant. 'Alien colors for island summer-na!'

steps.prompt: A tropical bird steals the Manager's sunglasses! Who catches it?

options.resultDialogue: She leaps through the air like a ninja. She gets the glasses back and barks at the bird. Squirrel power!
She draws a perfect, juicy berry on a leaf. The bird drops the glasses and falls for the drawing. Art wins!
She shimmers brightly, startling the bird. It drops the glasses and bows to her. Ethereal!

steps.prompt: Stand status?

options.resultDialogue: Risu is hugging the cash box. 'My precious shells-mogu!'
The stand is the talk of the pier. Great PR for ID Gen 1.
Iofi convinces tourists that the pineapples are UFO parts. They sell out instantly.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Stand is open. You found an old, heavy ritual bell buried in the sand.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help Advent unpack their plane-wreck base.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Shiori is carefully sniffing an old suitcase. 'It smells like... secrets and 1920s travel lotion.'

steps.prompt: The furniture is heavy. Who needs a hand?

options.resultDialogue: She’s moving a crate. She hums a work song, and before you know it, the whole room is unpacked.
She's organizing 'shiny things' she found. Most are just broken glass, but one is a polished silver disc.
She wants you to catalog 'The History of Abandoned Sandwiches.' You decline and move some chairs instead.

steps.prompt: The twins have found a 'Forbidden Button' in the wall. Push it?

options.resultDialogue: A secret panel opens revealing a stash of blue energy drinks. BAU BAU! The twins are delighted.
You stay professional. You find a manual for the plane instead. Safety over chaos.
She claims the button. Now anyone who wants to push it has to pay her one shiny rock. Economic genius.

steps.prompt: Base check?

options.resultDialogue: The base feels like a home now. A very strange, metallic home.
The twins are happy. The base is full of energy.
Shiori scribbles in her journal. 'The air in this wreckage feels... old.'

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Basecamp established. Shiori found an old piece of mirror-glass in a drawer.

noon.title: Day 1 — The Midday Heat
noon.openingDialogue: It's scorching. Choose a group to manage through the noon rush.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Manage the Gen 3 girls during the peak noodle rush.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Flare is sweating over the grill. Marine is complaining that her outfit was 'not made for humidity.'

steps.prompt: The register line is 100 people long. Who goes there?

options.resultDialogue: She processes payments like a machine. 'No refunds-peko!' The line moves out of fear.
She carries 10 plates at once. She is clearing the counter by herself. Knight power!
She coordinates the workflow like a general. The throughput is perfect. Flare is a pro.

steps.prompt: Marine is trying to sell 'Treasure Juice' (just standard OJ) for double price.

options.resultDialogue: You give her the 'Manager Stare.' She pouts and returns to normal waitressing. Honesty wins.
You help her set up a 'Captain's Corner' photo-op instead. It's a huge hit! Profit UP!
She starts a raffle. 'Buy a juice, win a carrot!' The fans are strangely competitive about it.

steps.prompt: Rush wrap?

options.resultDialogue: She cooks you a special bowl. Your stamina is refilled instantly!
Pekora counts the cash. 'We're rich-peko!'
She’s already asleep in the shade. Don't wake her.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Bistro survived. You found an old, heavy silver spoon in the sink.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Manage holoX at the splash zone.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: La+ is currently trying to declare the wave pool her sovereign territory.

steps.prompt: The slides are jammed. Who flushes them out?

options.resultDialogue: She uses ninja-agility to clear the jam in seconds. 'De gozaru!' The kids think she's a hero.
She gets stuck too. Now you have to rescue the rescuer. Managerial nightmare!
She uses a whistle and a mom-stare. The chaos stops immediately.

steps.prompt: Koyori wants to test a 'High-Velocity' lotion on the guests. Risk it?

options.resultDialogue: The fan hits 80mph on the slide. They land in the next lagoon. They love it!
Safety first. Koyori pouts but the island's safety rating stays perfect.
She calls it 'Dark Energy Lotion.' It’s just normal cream with food coloring. The fans pay double.

steps.prompt: Splash status?

options.resultDialogue: Lui gives you a dry towel. You needed that.
La+ stands on a floatie. 'The ocean obeys me!' Sure, kid.
Koyori is scribbling notes. 'The friction levels were fascinating!'

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Water park is a hit. You found an old, rusty key in the pool filter.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help NePoLaBo build a beach fortress.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Botan is currently mounting a high-pressure water cannon on a tower made of sand.

steps.prompt: The tide is coming in! Who fortifies the walls?

options.resultDialogue: She uses ice to freeze the wet sand. The walls are now rock-hard and ice-cold. Perfect defense!
She adds 100 seal statues for 'spiritual protection.' It's not sturdy, but it is adorable.
She fills the moat with glitter. The beach is now visible from space. Polka magic!

steps.prompt: Botan wants to test the cannon on an 'unauthorized' observer in the forest. Stop her?

options.resultDialogue: The cannon blast reveals a lost fan who was trying to climb a tree. Botan smirks. 'Target neutralized.'
You stay professional. You find a rare tropical flower instead. Lamy is pleased.
She sings a seal-song. The water cannon turns into a bubble machine. The fans love it!

steps.prompt: Who is the King of the Fort?

options.resultDialogue: A sturdy, professional sand-fortress.
A beautiful, frozen castle in the sun.
It sparkles brilliantly before partially collapsing. Iconic.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Castle is finished. Botan found a strange metallic chip deep in the sand.

evening.title: Day 1 — Evening Glow
evening.openingDialogue: Lanterns are flickering to life. The first night ceremony is starting near the shrine.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help Gen 4 prepare the opening lanterns.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Watame is currently trying to write 'I am not delicious' on every single lantern.

steps.prompt: The lighter is missing. Who provides the spark?

options.resultDialogue: She handles the flame with devilish grace. TMT! TMT! The lanterns glow holy-blue.
She accidentally snaps the bamboo frame with her 50kg grip. You use your lighter instead. Overkill.
The sheer warmth of her song lights the wick. The lantern feels cozy and safe.

steps.prompt: Luna demands a 'Royal Escort' to the launch pad. Be her horse?

options.resultDialogue: You carry her. Your back cracks. But the fans are crying from the cuteness. Naano!
You walk beside her with a clipboard. Formal and efficient. She pouts for three hours.
Towa sighs but does it. 'I'm a devil, not a nanny!' The fans cheer for TMT.

steps.prompt: Launch status?

options.resultDialogue: The lanterns rise in a perfect line. A peaceful first night.
Towa leads a synchronized launch. Breathtaking and slightly eerie.
Luna watches with a smile. 'Good job, Manager.' Night 1 is done.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Ceremony ends. You found an ancient silver coin in the lantern crate.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help Justice keep the first night secure.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Elizabeth is checking the perimeter. Gigi is trying to arrest a statue for 'loitering.'

steps.prompt: A mysterious shadow moves near the mall. Who investigates?

options.resultDialogue: She uses her royal voice. The shadow stops. It's just a tourist. She sings an apology. PR saved!
She uses mechanical sensors. 'It's a low-frequency broadcast.' Justice is on the case!
She pounces. It's a trash can. She interrogation-mode: 'Who sent you?!'

steps.prompt: Raora found a 'Secret Map' on a bench. Show the group?

options.resultDialogue: The team studies it. Justice is now 100% more efficient at scouting. Let's go!
You stay focused on safety. The night is quiet and peaceful. Good job, Manager.
She turns the map into a coloring book. All tactical value is lost, but morale is high.

steps.prompt: End of shift?

options.resultDialogue: The team stands tall under the moon. The island is safe.
A quiet, successful first patrol. 5-star report.
Cecilia stares at the lighthouse. 'The shadow doesn't match the light.'

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Patrol wrap. Elizabeth found a heavy silver piece that looks like a mirror fragment.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Manage the boat tour with Subaru and Choco.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Subaru is currently hyperventilating into a paper bag because 'the water is looking at her.'

steps.prompt: Something is glowing deep below. Who dives?

options.resultDialogue: She dives and comes back with a beautiful pearl. The fans are staring... at the pearl, of course.
You push her head toward the glass. She screams, then sees a pretty turtle. 'Cute-shuba!' Fear gone.
She giggles so much the fans forget they were scared of the dark. Best light source!

steps.prompt: A hidden cave door is spotted underwater! Open it?

options.resultDialogue: The gate leads to an underwater shrine. You see an old stone altar. The boat shakes!
You maintain a safe tour. No tremors, just happy fans and lots of fish photos.
She blows it a kiss. The door... actually opens? 'Everything has a heart, Manager.' Wow.

steps.prompt: Landing status?

options.resultDialogue: Subaru falls off the boat one last time. Iconic finale.
The tour ends with 5-star reviews and zero possession cases.
Ayame waves goodbye. The fans are now her loyal oni-servants.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Tour is over. Choco found an **Old Ceremonial Knife** at the bottom of the reef.
